question: A researcher is studying the effects of hormones on different cells within the ovarian follicle. She adds follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) to a culture of ovarian follicle cells. She then measures the activity levels of different enzymes within the cells. Which enzyme and ovarian cell type would be expected to be stimulated by the addition of FSH?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: FSH -> stimulates granulosa cells -> aromatase activity -> opc. Aromatase; granulosa cell -> 95% CHAIN: FSH -> stimulates theca interna cells -> desmolase activity -> opa. Desmolase; theca interna cell -> 95%
enhanced_information: FSH is expected to stimulate aromatase activity in granulosa cells. This aligns with the consensus that FSH stimulates granulosa cells, leading to increased aromatase activity. The evidence path confirming the interaction between granulosa cells and aromatase supports this expectation.
